newsitem.title: USA: Seattle-Tacoma to drop oxyfuel program this winter.
newsitem.headline: Seattle-Tacoma to drop oxyfuel program this winter.

text.p: The Seattle-Tacoma, Washington, area meets federal air quality standards and will not participate in the oxygenated fuels program this winter, officials from the Puget Sound Air Pollution Control Agency said Wednesday.
"We now meet ambient air standards and we've prepared maintenance plans on how they will stay in attainment," an agency official said.
"Our board decided oxygenated fuels were no longer needed here," the official said, and will not be used this winter.
Use of oxygenated fuels to reduce winter air pollution is not required under the Clean Air Act for areas that meet federal air quality standards.
The official said oxygenated fuels would be kept in the region's air quality plan as a contingency measure to be used the following winter if the area dropped out of compliance with air standards.
